/-!
# The PCP theorem, MaxSNP and APX

The theorems at the end of this file state, for one explicit machine model and concrete binary
codes:

* the PCP theorem (ANONYMIZED–ANONYMIZED; ANONYMIZED–ANONYMIZED–ANONYMIZED–ANONYMIZED–ANONYMIZED), in its gap form — for some
  constant fraction `num / den`, every NP language reduces in polynomial time to 3-SAT so that
  members give satisfiable formulas and non-members give formulas of which every assignment
  leaves at least that fraction of the clauses unsatisfied (`pcp_gap`) — and in its verifier
  form `NP = PCP(O(log n), O(1))` (`pcp_theorem`);
* the problems of the syntactic class MaxSNP₀ are in NPO (`npo_maxSNP0`);
* MaxSNP-hard problems have no polynomial-time approximation scheme unless `P = NP`
  (`maxSNPHard_no_ptas`, for any family of approximation algorithms, one per precision, and
  `maxSNPHard_not_hasPTAS` for a uniform scheme);
* MAX-3-SAT and 3-OCCURRENCE MAX-3-SAT are MaxSNP-complete (ANONYMIZED–ANONYMIZED) and
  APX-complete (`max3SAT_maxSNPComplete`, `max3SAT3_maxSNPComplete`, `max3SAT_apxComplete`,
  `max3SAT3_apxComplete`).

Conventions:

* Machines: deterministic single-tape Turing machines over {blank, 0, 1, separator}; time is
  the number of steps, the halting step included. Polynomial bounds are `c * (n + 1) ^ k`. A
  computed function leaves its output from the head onward. NP is defined by polynomial-time
  verifiers that get instance and certificate as `pairWords x w`; `P = NP` means that every
  NP language is decided by a polynomial-time machine.
* Formulas: variables are natural numbers, a clause is a list of literals, a formula a list of
  clauses; `SAT.encode` writes indices and lengths in unary. An assignment is written as a word
  (bit `i` is the value of variable `i`; variables beyond the end are false).
* Optimization problems are relations `Sol x y v` (`y` is a solution of the instance `x`, of
  value `v`) on binary words, with a direction. MaxSNP is the class of NPO problems
  L-reducible to the syntactic class MaxSNP₀ of ANONYMIZED and ANONYMIZED (maximize, over
  structures `S` of a fixed signature on the universe of the instance, the number of tuples
  satisfying a fixed well-formed quantifier-free formula), APX the class of NPO problems
  approximable within a constant factor, and APX-hardness is with respect to PTAS-reductions
  (ANONYMIZED–ANONYMIZED).

Only Lean core is imported. `scripts/generate_challenge.py` generates this file from the
library; `Solution.lean` proves the theorems without importing it.
-/

@[expose] public section
